feeds.title: The Nashville Mom
feeds.description: The Nashville Mom is a place for families to connect with kid friendly events, restaurants and things to do in Nashville! Dawn and her family love exploring all things Nashville and sharing their adventures!

feeds.title: Music City Moms Blog
feeds.description: Music City Moms is an online community for parents in Middle Tennessee. This is the place where Nashville area moms connect. We have a great group of moms to answer questions, give advice, or just listen.

feeds.title: Andrea Fenise
feeds.description: AndreaFenise is a fashion, lifestyle & DIY blog that features fashion, style, and lifestyle design tips.

feeds.title: Sami Cone
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sami! Whether you've read my best-selling book or seen me on TV, I'm glad you found me here. As a Nashville wife and mom to two teenagers, I look forward to helping you live your best life on less & achieve your dreams!

feeds.title: Walking in Memphis in High Heels
feeds.description: Laura from Walking in Memphis in High Heels is a popular lifestyle blogger and who focuses on affordable fashion and shares her thoughts on fashion, beauty, motherhood, and more.

feeds.title: Hello! Happiness Blog
feeds.description: Hello Happiness is a Nashville based lifestyle blog dedicated to all things fashion and beauty, family and children, fitness and fun, food and drink, and anything else happy.

feeds.title: Nashville Wifestyles
feeds.description: Nashville Wifestyles is a Nashville Style Blog written by Ashley in which she talks about the latest trends, mom tips, and more. Ashley is a lover of anything beauty, fashion, or food. She plans on this being a lifestyle blog mainly because calling it a smorgasbord of all things I love just didn't sound as appealing or professional.

feeds.title: City Chic Living
feeds.description: I am Alexandra Nicole - a digital entrepreneur and mom of 3 from Memphis, Tennessee. City Chic Living is for the modern mom who seeks to be empowered through fashion and makeup tips, health and lifestyle choices, unconventional parenting ideas, and exploring their environment and the world around them.

feeds.title: His Mercy is New
feeds.description: I'm Candace. I'm just a girl thankful for new mercies every morning. Join me on my journey toward wellness physically, mentally, spiritually, and emotionally. We can learn together!

feeds.title: Jenny Cruger Photography Blog
feeds.description: Jenny Cruger established the simple. pure. organic. brand of motherhood photography, creating the idea of organic portraits for maternity, newborn, baby, and family sessions beginning in 2010 in the Nashville area, and went on to train top photographers across the country, including those in Texas, California, Atlanta and beyond, in creating a complete experience for clients from the beginning with planning sessions, studio wardrobes, and intimate moments between moms, dads, and their tiniest loves, to ending with luxury heirloom artwork in their homes.

feeds.title: Twila's Photography Blog
feeds.description: Twila is a seasoned wedding photographer with over 15 years of wedding photography experience. She offers a very custom approach to her couples and families. A wife and mother herself, she knows the importance and meaning of cherished photos and the role photography plays in a family's history.

feeds.title: Something Totally Different
feeds.description: I'm Lindsay Ferrier, a Nashville wife, and mother with a passion for family travel, (mostly) healthy cooking, exploring Tennessee, and raising kids without losing my mind in the process. This is where I share my discoveries with you, along with occasional deep thoughts, pop culture tangents, and a sprinkling of snark.

feeds.title: Living With Landyn
feeds.description: I am Landyn. I'm a working mama with two kids, still trying to find that work/mom/wife balance. My hope is to inspire you in this crazy life, be your daily dose of comic relief, and be the best girlfriend you never really knew you needed.

feeds.title: Lemons and Basil
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kaylee, a former full-time Interior Designer, now full-time mommy, part-time designer, and part-time food blogger! My family and I live in Franklin, TN and this is my little piece of the internet where I enjoy sharing my love for healthy food as well as a look into our day-to-day lives.

feeds.title: Happy Brown House
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Sara and Happy Brown House is my little corner of the web. It's the place where my passions and life collide. Posts on creative kids activities, homeschool, printables, and family life.

feeds.title: The Sometimes Glam Wife
feeds.description: My name is Brandi and I am a lifestyle and travel blogger in Nashville, Tennessee. I have lived in Nashville my whole life and love sharing my experiences.

feeds.title: Any Worth
feeds.description: Thoughts on sustainability, travel, and life from writer Christy Nicholson.

feeds.title: Franklin Bakehouse Blog
feeds.description: Downtown Franklin's bakery, deli, and market for locals, leaders & visitors. Bringing together the familiar & attentive while honoring the simpler times of personal service.

feeds.title: You, Me, & Tennessee
feeds.description: Travel blog featuring food, travel, and tourism in Tennessee and beyond. Carly is the author behind the blog.

feeds.title: Julie Couch Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Julie Couch Interiors, founded in 2006, is a Nashville based is a boutique interior design firm. Nashville interior designer Julie Couch is passionate about creating curated and collected homes; artful, sophisticated spaces that draw you in, offering a bit of drama and a little whimsy.

feeds.title: Family Focus Blog
feeds.description: Family Focus Blog has been named a top family blog for parenting resources. It was created in 2010 by Nashville mom blogger, Scarlet Paolicchi. She shares tips for better family life, parenting, family fun activities, eco-friendly lifestyle, family food ideas, family travel, and home decor.

feeds.title: Lynchburg Mama
feeds.description: I'm Shelly Maynard, creator of Lynchburg Mama. My mission is to bring families back together with recipes for dinner! Discover breakfast and lunch, too, as well as the best dessert recipes!
